when: authorized work reaches a verified checkpoint
precautions: review diff for destructive changes, scope
--paths preserves unrelated work; include the checkpoint's generated changes
publication: st vcs publish --source ID --sha FULL_OID --now
commit before destructive ops (abandon, rollback)

cmd: st models route [--role JOB [--tool TOOL [--model M]] [--project P] | --task TASK] [--json]
when: pick a model for a job: --role JOB [--project P] lists each tool's model and effort, whether it is allowed, what usage it has left until when, Codex credits and its last refusal, so you choose; --tool adds one row's detail; st aico create applies the table's model by default. --task: completion-route advice; no options lists both

cmd: st prompt list | get | update | measure
when: editing agent prompts in DB
precautions: run st prompt measure before and after edits
keep prompts in DB; never duplicate as checked-in markdown
goal-first; ordered workflow only when order matters
agent-only text: terse imperative, no filler; heed STYLE_WARN

when: create a task; project from cwd
precautions: bare title creates a pending task; --plan/--type in --help

when: read task brief, plan, history
precautions: claim before implementing the assigned task; read-only inspection needs no claim
--subtask X.Y

when: record progress, decisions, or blockers on a claimed task
precautions: prefer task-id first form; trailing task-id is a legacy alias

when: read live lane and ownership state when a hint or refusal points at it
declare sweep scope before refactor; --hold a repo for integration; release on completion
precautions: the edit hook auto-leases each edited file and warns on another agent's lease; own st commit releases committed paths
relative globs resolve against the current checkout at acquire time
stale leases auto-release after 30min idle

when: iterate on a failing check; st commit already runs the quick check
precautions: never raw pytest/vitest/biome/tsc/ruff/sqlfluff/squawk
st check codeql: GitHub CodeQL alert state after code-scanning work

when: before implementing or completing an assigned task
precautions: subtask: dotted ID (1.2) + --task <parent>
commits go directly to main; conflicts point at st pulse

when: assigned-task closeout: acceptance, evidence, checkpoint cleanup
precautions: needs an active owned claim
scope defaults to the task's declared, leased or committed paths; else --paths a b
--evidence JSON for required deployment/live checks; never claim done while acceptance remains

cmd: st sessions send AGENT_OR_WINDOW 'question' [--fyi] | st sessions confirm ID [--withdraw] | st sessions ack ID yes|no 'why'|eta:MIN
when: ask another agent a question (<=500 chars; a brief file only for long material): it acks, you confirm; --fyi for a status note nobody needs to answer
precautions: address the coordinating parent; workers answer only their own requests; don't-touch: st lease --hold; fleet roots/native threads: --help

when: see requests waiting for your ack, and the state of requests you sent
precautions: Your sent requests read open/seen (recipient was shown it), open/unseen, or acked; close acked ones with st sessions confirm ID

when: check that backups are current, or see what the T7 and Google Drive hold and when they last worked
precautions: the first line says 'All backups current.' or lists the real problems
btrbk keeps 7 days on the T7; the daily Google Drive job is the offsite copy

when: get a project, postgres or redis dump, or a path back from the Google Drive backup
precautions: restores only into a new or empty directory, never over the live path
start with --dry-run to see which snapshot would be used
the restore is read back and verified before it reports success

when: deployed code/config/worker behavior changed (managed build+migrate+restart); never raw pnpm/npm/uv build or systemctl restart
precautions: explicit project, not cwd; resolve blockers its preflight reports
no ask needed: deploys committed HEAD only; preflight refuses when unsafe
full scope for shared or uncertain changes; worker scope includes backend consumers
required and active optional workers restart automatically; --include-all-workers also starts inactive optional workers

when: run an external tool through shared heavy-work admission
precautions: Resource admission only; label is public, so omit secrets. Child argv runs without a shell and inherits admission.
Not for long disk/network jobs (restores, bulk downloads): run them throttled outside the lane, see docs/transient-heavy-work.md.

when: inspect browser/test VM state when changing or repairing it
precautions: for routine browser work use st browser, not st vm

cmd: st db tables|schema TABLE|count TABLE|sample TABLE [N]|query SQL [--store NAME]
when: inspect an Aico SQLite store; read queries only

cmd: st mockup add FILE --project ID --title TITLE [--note TEXT]
when: put an HTML design on its project review page; Use this one answers the asking session
read local /proc diagnostics; logs use st logs UNIT
